# package s7

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-otfp/protocols/s7"
```

Package s7 fingerprints Siemens S7comm (S7-300/400/1200/1500, LOGO!, soft PLCs and Snap7-based servers) over ISO-on-TCP.

Detection opens COTP with the calling TSAP of a programming device (0x0100) and a called TSAP for rack 0 and the CPU slots 2, 1 and 3 in turn, then sends S7 Setup Communication. An Ack-Data with the S7 protocol identifier 0x32 proves S7comm and gives the negotiated PDU size; a 0x72 protocol identifier identifies S7comm-plus.

In identify mode the system status lists 0x0011 (module identification: order number, hardware and firmware version) and 0x001C (component identification: PLC and module names, plant ID, serial number, module type) are read. Both are read-only diagnostics that engineering tools and HMIs query routinely.

## Types

### type Config

```go
type Config struct {
	// CalledTSAPs are tried in order until one is confirmed; nil means
	// 0x0102, 0x0101 and 0x0103 (rack 0, slots 2, 1 and 3).
	CalledTSAPs []uint16
	// CallingTSAP is the local TSAP; zero means 0x0100.
	CallingTSAP uint16
}
```
